scope: Series definitions and release conventions; not a complete historical release-calendar reconstruction.

series.availability: CPI for a reference month is released in the following month. The prior month's CPI cannot be presumed available at the start of the target month.
series.revision: Seasonally adjusted CPI can be revised when seasonal factors are updated.

series.availability: Monthly household-survey unemployment rate in the Employment Situation release; reference month and publication date differ.
series.revision: Seasonally adjusted snapshot; historical vintages are not stored here.

series.availability: The first estimate is normally published around the middle of the following month. Do not infer availability from the reference-month timestamp.
series.revision: Monthly and annual revisions; release exceptions require a historical calendar for a real-time exercise.

series.availability: Monthly average of daily effective rates, not the FOMC target rate. Full-month aggregation and publication availability must be distinguished from individual daily observations.
series.revision: No historical publication or vintage timestamps in the snapshot.

series.availability: EIA monthly spot-price series. An available daily spot quote does not establish when this monthly series was available historically.
series.revision: No historical publication or vintage timestamps in the snapshot.

interpretation: FRED's current historical values and information available at a past forecast origin differ. This audit does not certify a real-time backtest.

chosen_policy.name: month_end_next_month_forecast
chosen_policy.macro_reference_month: t-2 for all five predictors, including lagged inflation
chosen_policy.assumption: Monthly observations are available by the end of the following month. This is a conservative convention, not verified historical release dates.
chosen_policy.live_requirement: Use actual released_at timestamps and observation vintages; never treat this assumption as proof of availability.

historical_example.implication: December CPI and industrial production were unavailable at the 2016-12-31 forecast origin for January 2017.
